summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the conclusion of a fractional share auction following the conversion of preferred shares (PNA1 and PNB1) into common shares at a 1.1:1 ratio, as part of the company's migration to the Novo Mercado segment approved at an EGM on April 1, 2026. The auction sold 21,632 common shares at an average price of BRL 50.16 per share, net of fees. Proceeds will be distributed to holders by July 28, 2026. This is a routine corporate action—a share conversion and fractional share sale—not a special situation such as a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. There are no deal terms, premium, or strategic change; it is a procedural step in listing migration.
